Secondly, that the sophisms confute themselves. And thirdly, that even boys might acquire this most trifling artifice in the space of two days. Soon after this, he descends from the sophist: to the rhetorician, for each of these falsely profeflbs political virtue, as we learn from the Gorgias. And he shows that rhetoricians, while they profess themselves to be both politicians and philosophers, are pcrfetSlly useless for the purposes of either.
